headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models
dek: Astra targets complex projects and Sol everyday tasks, per OpenAI.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The launch
body: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, per TechRadar, SiliconANGLE and Tecmundo.
Both reach ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API; free accounts are left out (TechRadar).

points.t: Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu get access (TechRadar).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Results
body: Astra scored 5.2 points above GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam, at under a third of the cost (SiliconANGLE).
It finished 5.5 points ahead of Claude Fable 5.2, at 5% of the cost (TechRadar).

items.t: Top cyber risk level, per OpenAI.
Not yet in the researcher program (Tecmundo).
Enterprise and Edu need an admin (SiliconANGLE).

caption.hook: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol for paying ChatGPT subscribers.
body: Per TechRadar, SiliconANGLE and Tecmundo, Astra targets complex professional projects and Sol everyday tasks. Both are in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu plans, and free accounts do not get access.

OpenAI says Astra scored 5.2 points above GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam, at under a third of the cost per task. The company also says the models hit its highest cybersecurity risk level, so they are not yet in Daybreak, its program for security researchers.
caption.cta: Save it for later and send it to someone following AI.
